summary: OpenAI published a case-studies page detailing ten sample questions, prompts, and datasets from its GeneBench-Pro genomics benchmark.

practices.reason: The detailed prompts, grading criteria, and multi-file datasets illustrate a rigorous methodology for evaluating quantitative reasoning on real-world genomics data, which a team could study to design comparable domain-specific evaluations.
practices.quote: These 10 case studies showcase representative questions from GeneBench-Pro. Each case study includes the original prompt, datasets, and supporting materials.
